description: Append text key by key to an input, contenteditable composer or combobox, using a selector or a11y ref. Fires per-key input events for suggestions and rich editors. Optional delay_ms spaces keystrokes. Text is never logged or returned. Requires agent control in supervised sessions and uses fill action permissions.

delay_ms.description: Delay between keystrokes in milliseconds. Default: 0.

frame.description: A CSS selector for an iframe, or a list of them for nested iframes. selector, label and ref then resolve inside it.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

ref.description: An element ref from this page's latest get_a11y_tree, such as e5, or f1e3 inside an iframe.

selector.description: CSS selector. Either selector or ref is required.

text.description: Text to append key by key, without clearing the field.

name: type
title: Type text key by key
